name: Mei Li Tan
bio:
Mei Li Tan's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the complex world of supply chain logistics. After graduating with a degree in Engineering from the National University of Singapore, she spent several years optimizing the delivery of high-precision components for the aerospace industry. A chance encounter with a race team owner during a business conference opened her eyes to the intricacies of motorsport operations. The challenge of coordinating hundreds of parts, personnel, and resources across continents for a single race ignited a passion she hadn't known she possessed.

At Manthey Racing, Mei Li is known for her meticulous planning and ability to anticipate potential roadblocks. Her approach is data-driven, always seeking to improve efficiency and reduce downtime. While she values collaboration, she often prefers to delve into the details independently, ensuring every aspect of the operation meets her exacting standards. Her blend of technical acumen and logistical expertise makes her an invaluable asset to the team, ensuring smooth operations even under the immense pressure of race day.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly tied back in a low bun with a few strands framing her face
physical.description: Mei Li is of average height, with a focused gaze and a practical demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with flowcharts and checklists.
Has a peculiar fondness for lemon-ginger tea, drinking multiple cups throughout the day.
Insists on personally inspecting the team's equipment inventory before every major race.
